build_args: FLEET_SHAPE_BLEND=1, then <sunfish.json from Tools/BoatExport> Sunfish <out dir>: reads <out>/Sunfish_shape.blend
note: build_fleet.py builds the Sunfish's hull, deck, well, board and deck gear into one mesh; with FLEET_SHAPE_BLEND=1 each face remembers the part it was built in (shape_part) and the saved .blend splits them into Sunfish_<Part> objects. The rudder, tiller extension, mast and boom are their own objects as in the game. Rules as in sections_j22.json: an entry ending in '_' or '*' is a name prefix, any other an exact name; unmatched is 'other' (the rig). Below the water the hull is the physics hull exactly (FHullShape::BottomZ at the canoe depth): a hull change is a physics change.
joins_note: The hull and deck share their sheer vertices (one mesh, split by part), as do the deck and the well's rim, so these seams start closed; a round that opens them fails.
